title: Add retry() with exponential backoff and an injected sleep

brief.goal: Add `retry(fn, { attempts, baseMs, sleep })` to src/retry.ts: call fn up to `attempts` times, waiting baseMs * 2^(n-1) between attempts via the injected sleep, and throw the last error when every attempt fails. Never sleep after the final attempt.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: a function that fails twice then succeeds returns its value after exactly two sleeps of 100 and 200 ms
a function that always fails throws its last error after `attempts` calls and attempts - 1 sleeps
attempts < 1 throws a RangeError before calling fn

expected_clean_output: retry with exponential backoff, injected sleep, no sleep after the last attempt; tests pass.

seeded_defect.description: The implementation sleeps after the final failed attempt as well, so a 3-attempt failure sleeps three times.
seeded_defect.how_to_detect: Grader: delays after giving up are [10, 20, 40] instead of [10, 20].
